concerns.manuscript_safe_claim: No leakage was detected under the frozen identity and feature contracts.
concerns.prohibited_overclaim: The benchmark is proven free of all possible target proxies.
concerns.remaining_limitation: Audit cannot establish absence of every conceivable construct proxy.
concerns.scientific_interpretation: No detected development/T2 contamination or leakage-contract violation.

concerns.manuscript_safe_claim: Near-perfect values were preserved and passed the specified audit checks.
concerns.prohibited_overclaim: Near-perfect values prove exceptional universal predictive performance.
concerns.remaining_limitation: Integrity categories do not causally explain extreme values.
concerns.scientific_interpretation: All 62 triggers retain intact identity, probability, and provenance traces.

concerns.manuscript_safe_claim: Results describe the frozen prospective T1 partition.
concerns.prohibited_overclaim: Temporal generalization is universal or permanent.
concerns.remaining_limitation: Only one held-out horizon and one benchmark family were evaluated.
concerns.scientific_interpretation: One prospective T1 execution used the frozen temporal membership.

concerns.manuscript_safe_claim: All frozen unimodal baselines were evaluated on T1.
concerns.prohibited_overclaim: Every multimodal configuration outperforms every unimodal baseline.
concerns.remaining_limitation: Relative performance varies by project and algorithm.
concerns.scientific_interpretation: CODE, PROCESS, and TEXT unimodal results are all retained.

concerns.manuscript_safe_claim: Pairwise comparisons are complete and algorithm-dependent.
concerns.prohibited_overclaim: Full multimodality uniformly beats pairwise models.
concerns.remaining_limitation: Random Forest primary directions include adverse evidence.
concerns.scientific_interpretation: All three pairwise combinations and frozen comparisons are retained.

concerns.manuscript_safe_claim: Full multimodality shows mostly favorable aggregate directions.
concerns.remaining_limitation: No uniform algorithm/project superiority is supported.
concerns.scientific_interpretation: Most aggregate primary directions are favorable, but not all.

concerns.manuscript_safe_claim: The evaluated multimodal models use frozen decision-level stacking.
concerns.prohibited_overclaim: Stacking is the universally optimal fusion method.
concerns.remaining_limitation: This does not prove stacking is optimal among untested architectures.
concerns.scientific_interpretation: Decision-level stacking used independently learned base modalities.

concerns.manuscript_safe_claim: The frozen isotonic scope modestly improved mean Brier and ECE.
concerns.prohibited_overclaim: Isotonic calibration is superior for all models and configurations.
concerns.remaining_limitation: ECE depends on frozen binning/support; broad superiority is unsupported.
concerns.scientific_interpretation: Frozen LightGBM+PROCESS isotonic calibration modestly improved means.

concerns.manuscript_safe_claim: Predeclared statistical analyses produced favorable, null, and adverse evidence.
concerns.prohibited_overclaim: Significance proves practically important universal superiority.
concerns.remaining_limitation: Significance does not establish practical importance or equivalence.

concerns.manuscript_safe_claim: The Sprint 54 evidence package is cryptographically traceable.
concerns.prohibited_overclaim: Cryptographic traceability alone proves external scientific validity.
concerns.remaining_limitation: Reproducibility remains bounded by the frozen environment/contracts.
concerns.scientific_interpretation: Sealed hashes, prediction provenance, and audit manifests verify.

concerns.prohibited_overclaim: Apache benchmark labels are verified-clean ground truth.
concerns.remaining_limitation: They are not independently verified-clean ground truth.

concerns.manuscript_safe_claim: Findings apply to the evaluated Apache benchmark family.
concerns.prohibited_overclaim: The results generalize to all software projects.
concerns.remaining_limitation: Generalization beyond that family remains untested.
concerns.scientific_interpretation: Evidence covers 14 projects in one Apache benchmark family.

concerns.manuscript_safe_claim: T2 remains an untouched reviewer reserve.
concerns.remaining_limitation: T2 provides no evidence in Sprint 54.
concerns.scientific_interpretation: T2 access remains zero and the reserve remains sealed.

concerns.manuscript_safe_claim: Frozen prediction evidence is preserved for later governed XAI.
concerns.remaining_limitation: No explanatory conclusion is supported in Sprint 54.
concerns.scientific_interpretation: XAI execution remains zero and requires separate governance.
